entities.name: Khudal
entities.description: Rakshasa vizier of the Sultai who framed Yala for his own poisoning attempt.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: Sultai khan targeted by an attempt on his life.

entities.name: Yala
entities.description: Honorable warrior falsely accused and killed.

events.summary: After an attempt on Tasigur's life Ikra Shidiqi brings him to Khudal, who names the warrior Yala.
events.quote: Khudal told him it was the honorable warrior Yala

events.summary: Tasigur breaks his promise and kills the innocent Yala.
events.quote: Tasigur did not keep his promise, and killed Yala

events.summary: Khudal admits the poison was his own, having wanted Yala's soul, and fades away.
events.quote: Khudal admitted the poison had been his own

relations.quote: Khudal was a rakshasa vizier of the Sultai
Tasigur did not keep his promise, and killed Yala
Ikra Shidiqi brought him to Khudal's chamber
